name: Organizational Behavior Graduate Certificate (Online)
tuitionIncludes: Tuition for four courses at the published 2026–27 rate of $3,580 per course. Harvard states that books, course materials, supplies, equipment, and certain transaction-related fees may be additional; lodging and meals are not included.
cohortSeniority: Select certificate-earner titles published by the school: Business Analyst, Customer Success Manager, Director of Operations, Program Manager, Principal, and Vice President; the school does not say these titles represent a majority.

ratingNotes.leadership_skills: Required organizational behavior and conflict management courses, with electives such as Leading Through Change.
ratingNotes.deep_expertise: Four graduate-credit courses in organizational behavior, without a capstone.
ratingNotes.graduate_degree: Courses can count toward a Harvard Extension master's in management or industrial-organizational psychology.
ratingNotes.senior_network: In 2024, over half of students had 11+ years of employment; online, with no required time together.
ratingNotes.new_industry_or_city: Career webinars, advising and career fairs are open to certificate students.

figureNotes.cohortMedianExperienceYears: Median from Harvard's 2024 fast facts for students pursuing this certificate (years of employment by band); the middle student falls in the 11-20 band, stored at its lower edge.

name: Blended Professional Certificate: Technology Leadership Program
credential: Certificate of Completion from MIT Professional Education
onsiteNote: 3 residential weeks and 14+ live online sessions
campusAddress: 700 Technology Square Building NE48-200 Cambridge, MA 02139 USA
cohortSeniority: Technology leaders and experienced practitioners; relevant roles include C-level positions, Heads of Engineering/Technology, engineering managers, product managers, team leaders, senior functional managers, and delivery heads.

ratingNotes.leadership_skills: Leadership is the core: leading strategic change, the human side of technology, and innovation teams.
ratingNotes.deep_expertise: Several technology strategy modules and strategy projects throughout, without academic credit.
ratingNotes.graduate_degree: Certificate of completion with 42 CEUs; no stated path to a graduate degree.
ratingNotes.senior_network: Half of past participants have 20+ years of experience, across 20+ industries; three residential weeks at MIT.
ratingNotes.new_industry_or_city: An MIT Professional Education alumni LinkedIn group; no career services published.
